job.organization: Madera Unified School District - Personnel Commission

items.item_text: 01. The following supplemental questions will help us determine how well you meet the minimum employment qualification standards for this position. Respond honestly and truthfully to all questions. Experience listed below must be represented in the work history section of your application. A resume may be attached, but not substituted for completing the work history, education sections, or the supplemental questions of the employment application. Providing incomplete responses or answering "See Resume" or "See Application" may automatically disqualify your application from further consideration. Only the most qualified applicants who pass the minimum qualifications review will be invited to the examination process. I acknowledge that I have read and understand the above statement. Options: Yes | No

02. Do you have experience working in a school office? Include the name of the school or educational institution, your job title, dates of employment, and the length of time you performed these duties. Providing incomplete responses or answering "See Resume" or "See Application" may automatically disqualify your application from further consideration. Only the most qualified applicants who pass the minimum qualifications review will be invited to the examination process. I acknowledge that I have read and understand the above statement.

03. Please describe your experience performing secretarial, clerical, or recordkeeping duties. Include the name of the school or educational institution, your job title, dates of employment, and the length of time you performed these duties. Providing incomplete responses or answering "See Resume" or "See Application" may automatically disqualify your application from further consideration. Only the most qualified applicants who pass the minimum qualifications review will be invited to the examination process. I acknowledge that I have read and understand the above statement.

04. Describe your experience maintaining, reviewing, processing, or updating student records. Which types of records have you worked with? (Examples: cumulative files, transcripts, enrollment records, attendance, grades, report cards, graduation records, or student withdrawals.) Include the name of the school or educational institution, your job title, dates of employment, and the length of time you performed these duties. Providing incomplete responses or answering "See Resume" or "See Application" may automatically disqualify your application from further consideration. Only the most qualified applicants who pass the minimum qualifications review will be invited to the examination process. I acknowledge that I have read and understand the above statement.

05. Describe your experience responding to questions and requests from students, parents, school staff, other educational institutions, or members of the public regarding student records or enrollment information. Include the name of the school or educational institution, your job title, dates of employment, and the length of time you performed these duties. Providing incomplete responses or answering "See Resume" or "See Application" may automatically disqualify your application from further consideration. Only the most qualified applicants who pass the minimum qualifications review will be invited to the examination process. I acknowledge that I have read and understand the above statement.

06. Describe any experience reviewing, interpreting, or processing student transcripts, academic records, or educational documents. Have you been responsible for verifying grades, calculating credits, or determining whether academic requirements have been met? Include the name of the school or educational institution, your job title, dates of employment, and the length of time you performed these duties. Providing incomplete responses or answering "See Resume" or "See Application" may automatically disqualify your application from further consideration. Only the most qualified applicants who pass the minimum qualifications review will be invited to the examination process. I acknowledge that I have read and understand the above statement.

07. What student information systems or other electronic recordkeeping databases have you used in a school setting? Please identify the systems and describe the types of information you entered, updated, retrieved, or maintained. Include the name of the school or educational institution, your job title, dates of employment, and the length of time you performed these duties. Providing incomplete responses or answering "See Resume" or "See Application" may automatically disqualify your application from further consideration. Only the most qualified applicants who pass the minimum qualifications review will be invited to the examination process. I acknowledge that I have read and understand the above statement.
08. State regulations limit our ability to hire retirees receiving benefits from certain public retirement plans. Are you currently receiving retirement benefits from CalPERS? Options: Yes | No
09. If the answer is yes, please list the retirement system you are retired from (CAL PERS or CAL STRS) and enter the last four digits of your Social Security number and the date you retired.

10. I have attached a copy of my high school diploma, official high school transcripts, or high school equivalency. Only copies of official transcripts or a copy of the diploma are acceptable. Failure to do so will result in my application being deemed incomplete. Options: Yes | No
